import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Define the path to the shared libraries
LIB_GSLCBLAS = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
LIB_GSL = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

# Load the shared libraries
ctypes.CDLL(LIB_GSLCBLAS, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL(LIB_GSL)

# Define the cblas_ddot function from the cblas library
cblas_ddot = ctypes.CDLL(LIB_GSLCBLAS).cblas_ddot
cblas_ddot.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_int]
cblas_ddot.restype = ctypes.c_double

def cblas_ddot_wrapper(vector_x, vector_y):
    # Validate input
    if not isinstance(vector_x, (list, np.ndarray)) or not isinstance(vector_y, (list, np.ndarray)):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be lists or numpy arrays.")
    if len(vector_x) != len(vector_y):
        raise ValueError("Vectors must have the same length.")

    # Convert Python lists to ctypes arrays
    N = len(vector_x)
    X = (ctypes.c_double * N)(*vector_x)
    Y = (ctypes.c_double * N)(*vector_y)
    incX = ctypes.c_int(1)
    incY = ctypes.c_int(1)

    # Call the cblas_ddot function
    result = cblas_ddot(N, X, incX, Y, incY)
    return result

def assert_test():
    # Test cases
    vector_x = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    vector_y = [4.0, 5.0, 6.0]
    assert np.isclose(cblas_ddot_wrapper(vector_x, vector_y), 32.0), "Test case 1 failed"

    vector_x = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    vector_y = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    assert np.isclose(cblas_ddot_wrapper(vector_x, vector_y), 0.0), "Test case 2 failed"

    vector_x = [1.0, -1.0, 1.0]
    vector_y = [-1.0, 1.0, -1.0]
    assert np.isclose(cblas_ddot_wrapper(vector_x, vector_y), -3.0), "Test case 3 failed"

    print("All test cases passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
